authoring: Generated by SAIL_KIT.sailing() (Art/_sailKit.js) off the live rig: sailPose() sampled for every pose number, the loft integrated for the hull form, the bake measured for the envelope, INTERACT read from the geometry sidecar generated in the same run. AUTO_TRIM is the builder page’s law verbatim. POLAR_REFERENCE is a stated model over rig-derived inputs, flagged. Do not hand-edit — re-run SAIL_KIT.write().

HULL_FORM.provenance: trapezoidal integration of the rig loft (station/skin/halfAtZ/fracAtZ) below z = DWL over 120 stations x 24 waterlines; seawater 1025 kg/m3. CANOE BODY ONLY — the fin keel, bulb and rudder (WATERLINE.draft_m in the geometry sidecar) are not integrated. The bow rake shifts y by at most 0.1 m and is read from skin(), not ignored.

SAIL_PLAN.rig: fractional sloop · deck-stepped mast on the coachroof · two swept spreader sets · split backstay · roller-furling jib
SAIL_PLAN.provenance: areas from SAIL in the geometry sidecar (main 0.5*P*E*roach factor; headsails 0.5*luff*LP); I = forestay head to forestay foot, J = forestay foot to the mast centreline at the deck (RIG consts)

AUTO_TRIM.law: main sheet limit = clamp(|awa|-18, 0, 86) deg -> main = clamp01(1-(limit-4)/82); headsail limit = clamp(|awa|-16, 0, 85) -> jib = clamp01(1-(limit-9)/76)
AUTO_TRIM.meaning: 18 deg of attack on the main and 16 on the headsail — full fill (fill saturates at aoa 18) — until the sheet limits (86 / 85) cap them downwind
AUTO_TRIM.source: Sloop 30 Iso.dc.html _autoTrim(), the builder page’s ✦ AUTO-TRIM button; the trim every preset, strip and table in this file was sampled at

POINTS_OF_SAIL.note: pose law: |awa| < 25 with wind = in irons — every sail flogs whole, the boom wanders about the centreline
pose law: |awa| > 150 = the headsail is blanketed by the main (fill x0.4)
pose law: aws < 0.5 = becalmed — the boom hangs near the centreline, no fill, no heel

HEEL.law: min(24, 0.067*aws^2*(0.25+0.75*fill_main)*k(awa)) to leeward; k=1 to 100°, 0.35 dead downwind; 15% in irons
HEEL.side: to leeward — the sails' side (sailPose().side: -1 = port)
HEEL.axis: roll about the boat origin (canoe-body bottom); the waterline on the sprite tilts, the shader cut stays level
HEEL.override: opts.heelDeg overrides the law per frame; opts.heel:false bakes level. Gameplay may run its own righting-moment model and feed the result in.

STATES.label: full sail
STATES.note: main up, headsail set. The working state — every POINTS_OF_SAIL preset is this state plus wind and trim.
headsail furled on the forestay (the roll wears the canvas slot)
main down — down · pack open — boom sheeted home (max 2 deg); the headsail alone draws
every sail stowed, cover off. The rig models no engine, propeller, exhaust or wake — propulsion, sound and the water are the game’s.
THE STORED STATE (builder: STOWED): main flaked into the stack pack, zipped, headsail furled. cover is only honoured at hoist 0.

TRANSITIONS.note: luff = P*hoist up the mast; run 1 -> 0 to lower. Continuous — sample as many frames as the cue wants; the builder strips show 0 / 0.5 / 1.
rolled onto the forestay; run 1 -> 0 to unfurl. The furling line runs down the port side deck to the coaming cleat.
only at hoist 0. No deck fitting drives it — a crew action at the boom; suggest the halyard_winch station.
the companionway — see THRESHOLD in the geometry sidecar; 8 baked frames, played reversed on exit

MANOEUVRES.sign: signed angles: negative = boom / clew to PORT (wind over the starboard bow), positive = to starboard

tack.through: in irons (|awa| < 25) — both sails flog, the boom wanders about the centreline, heel drops to 15%

gybe.through: dead downwind — the boom flips side as awa crosses 180; the pose law has no slam or preventer, the swing is instantaneous between samples

MANOEUVRES.boom_end_over: the cockpit, forward of the wheel
MANOEUVRES.note: the sprite follows awa; a tack or gybe is gameplay turning the boat through the wind and feeding the rig the awa of each frame. Timing is gameplay’s.

CONTROLS.effect: renderWheel(dir, {steer}) turns the wheel; the rudder follows with opts.underbody
boom limit = 4 + 82*(1-main) deg; the boom sits at min(limit, |awa|-6) to leeward. 1 = hardened (4 deg), 0 = eased (86 deg)
headsail limit = 9 + 76*(1-jib) deg; the clew sits at min(limit, |awa|-6). The working sheet is the leeward one.
luff = P*hoist; 0 parks the boom (max 2 deg) and grows the stack pack
rolled onto the forestay; rolled radius grows with furl, the UV strip is the canvas slot

WIND.awa: degrees, wrapped to -180..180 by the rig; + = wind over the STARBOARD bow (sails set to port)

from_true.heading_deg: dir * 45 (N = 0, clockwise) plus any yaw the game runs between facings
from_true.v: boat speed through the water, knots (POLAR_REFERENCE or the game’s own)

WIND.note: the rig only ever sees awa/aws/sheets. Everything before that — true wind, boat speed, leeway, current — is gameplay’s; this block is the glue so the sprite agrees with the physics.

POLAR_REFERENCE.status: REFERENCE, art-side. Gameplay owns the polar and drive (SAIL.pose_law note in the geometry sidecar). This one exists so a first physics pass and the sprite agree; replace the model, keep the glue.

model.v_kn: min( v_hull * (1 - exp(-tws / tws_h)) * G(twa),  R(twa) * tws )
model.v_hull_rule: 1.34 * sqrt(LWL_ft) — the displacement-hull limit; G lets a reach run 3% over it
model.tws_h_rule: 80 / (SA/D) — the true wind that brings her to 63% of hull speed
model.G_rule: linear between the points; 0 below twa 35 (no-go)
model.R_rule: boat speed never exceeds this fraction of the TRUE wind — the light-air governor; linear between the points

POLAR_REFERENCE.no_go: G = 0 below twa 35. Note the rig reads IN IRONS below awa 25, and awa is tighter than twa when she is moving (see rows where mode is "in irons" at twa 35–40): a boat sailed at the polar’s edge shows flogging sails. Pinch to the sprite’s 25 deg apparent, not the polar’s 35 true.
POLAR_REFERENCE.surfing_planing: not modelled — the shape caps at 1.03 * v_hull. A performance hull on a broad reach in a big breeze will exceed it; that is gameplay’s to add.

ANIMATION.loop: phase = 2*pi*frame/8 — cloth flutter at the luff, the in-irons boom wander, the winch handle when opts.grind is set; rock:true adds rock(frame) (roll/pitch/heave) and boat interiors take the same pose

where.main: the starboard cabin-top halyard winch (the 30 has no mainsheet winch — the mainsheet is a block and a pedestal cleat)

grind.note: a turning handle on that winch, one revolution per 8 frames; the LEEWARD winch is chosen from awa

ANIMATION.heel: a render param — heel is not animated by the rig, it follows aws/awa/fill each frame

SPRITE_ENVELOPE._units: cell px, [x0,y0,x1,y1] inclusive, measured off the alpha channel of render(dir, opts) at elev 40, frame 0, heel from the pose law
SPRITE_ENVELOPE.note: close_hauled_max_heel is the widest heel the pose law produces (aws 20 saturates it); run_boom_out is the boom at 86 deg; stored is the hull alone with the cover on. Pack from union_everything to hold the sailing envelope in one atlas cell.

_excluded.polar_ownership: the polar is gameplay’s (SAIL.pose_law). POLAR_REFERENCE is a reference model, not a claim about the boat.
_excluded.reefing: no reef points modelled on either hull. hoist < 1 shortens the luff along the mast and grows the pile on the boom — the only shortened-main picture is the nearest thing to a reef.
_excluded.engine: no engine, propeller, exhaust or wake. motoring is a sail state (everything stowed), the propulsion is the game’s.
_excluded.spinnaker: no downwind sail; dead downwind the headsail is blanketed and that is the picture.
_excluded.leeway_current: not in the rig; the sprite has no crab angle parameter — heading is the facing.
_excluded.anchoring_state: the anchor hangs on the roller in every state; no chain, no riding sail, no anchor light.

_confirm.polar_numbers: REFERENCE model — replace with the game’s VPP; keep WIND.from_true and the pose loop.
_confirm.no_go_coupling: the polar’s 35 deg true vs the rig’s 25 deg apparent in-irons band: rule which the player feels. Rows in POLAR_REFERENCE whose mode reads "in irons" are exactly the cells where the sprite would flog at the polar’s speed.
_confirm.displacement: canoe body only (4875 kg at the DWL); keel and bulb not integrated — add their volume before quoting a displacement.
_confirm.heavy_weather_as_reef: no reef state exists; rule whether hoist 0.7 reads as a reef or whether the rig needs reef points.
_confirm.heel_override: the heel law is art-side (capped 24 deg); gameplay may drive heelDeg from its own righting moment.
_confirm.envelope: measured at elev 40 only; the rigs’ cell-fit sweeps cover elev 30–50 (see the rig header)
